final: WITH g AS (SELECT BillingState AS st, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Invoice WHERE BillingState IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BillingState), s AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS avgc FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.st, g.c, g.c * 1.0 / s.tot AS ratio, g.c - a.avgc AS diff FROM g CROSS JOIN s CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.c > a.avgc) SELECT SUM(c), AVG(ratio), AVG(diff) FROM k
